# nemau_container (Resource)

An object storage container.

The provider manages the container but not its contents. Upload objects with the CLI or an SDK.

`object_lock` makes stored versions immutable for the retention period, as ransomware-resistant backups require. S3 cannot add object locking to an existing bucket, so `object_lock` and `retention_mode` force a replacement, and a container meant to hold immutable backups has to be created with object lock enabled.

In `COMPLIANCE` mode, objects cannot be erased before they expire, even by the platform, and `terraform destroy` fails while locked versions remain.

Only `versioning` and a longer `retention_days` change in place. The API does not shorten a retention period, because weakening a WORM guarantee is a support operation, and the plan refuses it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nemau_container" "backups" {
  name           = "backups"
  object_lock    = true
  retention_days = 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Container name. Changing it replaces the container.

### Optional

- `object_lock` (Boolean) Make versions immutable (WORM). Cannot be changed after creation.
- `retention_days` (Number) How long objects stay immutable, in days, at most 2555 (seven years). Requires `object_lock`. Can be raised in place, never lowered.
- `retention_mode` (String) `GOVERNANCE` (the default; the platform can lift the lock) or `COMPLIANCE` (nobody can lift it before it expires).
- `versioning` (Boolean) Keep previous versions of objects. Implied by `object_lock`, and cannot be turned off while it is on. Changes in place.

### Read-Only

- `bytes` (Number) Bytes stored in the container.
- `id` (String) Same as `name`.
- `immutable` (Boolean) True when the store enforces WORM. The value is read from the store rather than derived from the configuration, so it shows what an audit would observe.
- `object_count` (Number) Number of objects in the container.
- `s3_bucket` (String) Bucket name to address in S3 tooling with a `nemau_container_credential` of this container. It differs from `name`: the object store knows each container under an opaque name.

## Import

```shell
# A container imports by its name.
terraform import nemau_container.backups backups
```
